Welcome to “Beach Breeze”!



This beautiful newly renovated in spring 2020 beach home is located in the popular community of Summers's Edge in Seagrove Beach. It has stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico from several of it's FIVE decks and is sure to be the perfect location for your family's next vacation getaway!



The beach access is only 50 yards away, along with two community pools (one of which is seasonally heated) that are also only a short stroll from the home!



On the first floor of the home, you will enter the first of two living areas. This set-up makes it perfect for older kids to have their own space, or even two different families to have room to spread out and relax! There are three bedrooms on this level, the first featuring two sets of twin sized bunk beds, and the second with a queen-sized bed! There is a shared bathroom off the hallway. The third bedroom features a queen-sized bed and attached bathroom with shower.



Out back, is the perfect outdoor space to spend the evenings, the screened in porch!



As you make your way to the second level of the home, you will enter the spacious open concept living, kitchen and dining area. Gather around on the large sectional in the living room for family movie nights on the flat screen or spend time on the second level balcony making your beach plans for the day! The beautifully appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances, and a table that can seat up to 4 guests. There is also a large dining area equipped with a table that can seat an additional 8 guests! The 4th bedroom with a King-sized bed in on this level also.



The third-floor tower room is sure to be everyone’s favorite spot to hangout! Equipped with a cozy sofa that turns into a queen sleeper, flat screen T.V. and a wet bar, the inside space is just the beginning! Enjoy wonderful gulf views from the balcony, and really take in the beach breezes!



Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bikes, beach chairs, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!

Starter Amenity Package:



Starter Amenity Package:

All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING: Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



FAQ's:

Type of coffee pot: K cup or standard coffee pot

Parking spots: 3 vehicles Max

Distance to beach: Drive: 50 yards to the beach

Bikes included: no (can use rental credit towards bikes.)

Beach Chairs & Umbrella set-up included: NO

Community Pool heated: Yes



Summers Edge is just 1.8 miles from the town of Seaside. The community is just minutes away from shopping, restaurants and many other activities in Seaside, Watercolor, Rosemary Beach, Destin and Panama City. There are great bike paths, lakes, the beach, and state parks nearby to provide plenty of outdoor activities.

* Golf carts are not allowed*

**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located by the ocean, this vacation home is in Seagrove Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach. Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.

reviews.text: We stayed in Beach Breeze in June 25. We had an excellent stay. Walk to the beach was short and lots of shade. The beach was public but you could set up chairs and umbrellas behind the paid ones you have to pay for. We had the A/C go out one day but they mgt company was very responsive sent someone out quickly. Kitchen had everything you needed. Would recommend for families.
